title: Mitsubishi 939P03307 Vintage VCR Remote Control for Many 1980's-1990's Models
categoryName: Consumer Electronics:TV, Video & Home Audio:TV, Video & Audio Accessories:Remote Controls
descriptionText: The Mitsubishi 939P03307 Vintage VCR Remote Control is a black wireless remote designed for many Mitsubishi VCR models from the 1980s to 1990s. With a sleek design and wireless connectivity, this remote allows for easy operation of your vintage VCR from a distance. The model number 939P033070 ensures compatibility with a wide range of Mitsubishi VCR models, making it a convenient accessory for those looking to enhance their home entertainment experience with a touch of nostalgia.
